key_insight: SpheRoPE shows that 360° panoramic images and videos can be generated without extra training or test-time optimization by injecting spherical geometry directly into pre-trained diffusion transformers. The key idea is to turn existing latent panoramic priors into reliable full-sphere generation through spherical rotary positional encoding (RoPE).
problem_solved: The paper addresses the difficulty of generating seamless 360° panoramas with current diffusion models, which typically require either expensive fine-tuning on limited panoramic datasets or slow multi-step optimization at inference time.
method: Inject spherical priors into pre-trained diffusion transformers using spherical RoPE, preserving zero-shot generation.
Avoid any panorama-specific fine-tuning or optimization, making the approach training-free and inference-efficient.
Leverage the panoramic structure already present in large-scale generative models to produce consistent 360° images and videos.
impact: This makes panoramic generation far more practical for researchers and practitioners who need high-quality 360° content without collecting specialized data or paying heavy compute costs. It also suggests that geometric priors can unlock new capabilities in foundation generative models with minimal modification.
